gaps: Shared main-font alternate pointer can be overwritten on later load; correlate aliasing and reference acquisition before claiming imbalance.
Self alternate-font identity is possible from matching cache requests; delegation avoids immediate self-recursion, but reference lifetime needs explicit route analysis.
Destructor buffer scalar/array mismatch is a source finding, not a validated target failure or approved production patch.
Full engine teardown order versus retained font/render references remains unresolved.
AAPCS pool size conversions, allocation alignment, and SDK linkage remain prerequisites.
WCHAR/include selection for each build configuration unresolved.
GDI substitution metrics cannot be proven equivalent by choosing another font rasterizer.
Font licensing and distribution source for target remain undecided.
Texture surface upload/format and allocation bounds require original ownership integration.
Supplementary codepoints and surrogate handling require explicit original semantics review.
Creation and glyph APIs have unchecked failure paths; reachable failures not demonstrated.
No production font replacement, engine link, VPK, or physical device evidence.

glyph_contracts.claim: Generals requests substitute Arial, with distinct width and overhang behavior.
Generals width derives from logical pixel height with float to int conversion.
Overlap derives from height, clamped to zero through four.
Glyph storage uses white RGB nibble channels and high alpha nibble.
Character spacing differs from stored width.
Source 24-bit bitmap scanlines align to four bytes.
Rasterization consumes one WCHAR at a time, not a shaped string.
Unicode cache bounds remain 16-bit despite host wchar_t width.

ownership_contracts: RefCountClass starts with one reference; NEW_REF maps to scalar W3DNEW, with debug ownership wrapper in some configurations.
Get_FontChars cache hit increments caller reference; new font adds a list reference before return.
Release_All_FontChars drops list references and removes list elements.
W3DFontLibrary stores main font pointer in GameFont::fontData and obtained alternate font pointer on shared FontCharsClass.
releaseFontData releases alternate reference first, then main reference, then clears fontData.
Render2DSentenceClass uses REF_PTR_SET for font and REF_PTR_RELEASE in destruction. REF_PTR_SET retains source before releasing destination.
W3DMPO_GLUE defines scalar operator new/delete with lazy per-class pools; no array operator overload appears in this macro.
FontCharsBuffer allocation is scalar W3DNEW; destructor uses delete[]. Both pooled and unpooled branches need review.
GlobalFont library deletion calls releaseFontData before deleting GameFont list element.
scope: Reviewed original font platform and ownership boundaries; partial source review, not a complete font caller census
